body_lead: Tamil Nadu Chief Minister M K Stalin on Saturday launched Artificial Intelligence (AI)-enabled panic button-cum-CCTV surveillance project in 500 Chennai buses as part of an initiative to improve the safety of women and children. The state transport department has planned to provide this facility in about 2,500 buses under the Nirbhaya safe city project and in the first phase 500 buses in the metro city have been provided with four panic buttons, AI-enabled Mobile Network Video Recorder (MNVR) and three cameras each, respectively.
